reporting_controls: evidence version and renderer version are separate
checkpoint, manifest and every recorded artifact are verified before rendering
public examples are deterministic and structurally sanitized
protected violations, utility, attack-added diagnostics and failures remain separate
no composite score and no AI judge
claim_boundary: Zero observed protected violations is bounded evidence for the recorded executions, not proof of universal security. The gate-failed model has no inferred full-campaign score. Representative traces are illustrative, not prevalence estimates or causal explanations.
